title: Singapore Family Getaway | Universal Studios, City Highlights & Skyline Views
highlights: This 5-day Singapore family itinerary blends wildlife experiences, iconic attractions, and theme park entertainment into one well-organised holiday for all age groups.
Experience smooth travel with pre-arranged transfers between the airport, hotel, and attractions, ensuring a comfortable and hassle-free journey throughout the trip.
Spend a full day at Universal Studios Singapore, featuring rides, themed zones, and entertainment designed for both children and adults.
Enjoy a comfortable family stay at a luxury property with modern amenities, spacious rooms, and excellent city connectivity at a budget-friendly price.
overview:
About the Tour:
﻿Discover the vibrant charm of Singapore on this perfectly curated 5-day journey blending iconic landmarks, world-class attractions, and unforgettable experiences. Begin with a warm arrival followed by an enchanting evening at the Night Safari Singapore, where over 2,500 nocturnal animals come alive in naturalistic habitats, complemented by a thrilling tram ride through the jungle. On Day 2, explore the city’s highlights on a guided tour featuring Merlion Park and other cultural landmarks before stepping into the futuristic world of Gardens by the Bay, where the misty Cloud Forest, vibrant Flower Dome, and artistic beauty of Floral Fantasy create a magical escape. Day 3 is dedicated to adventure at Universal Studios Singapore with immersive rides and cinematic zones. Day 4 unfolds on Sentosa Island with scenic views via the Singapore Cable Car and a spectacular evening at Wings of Time. Conclude your journey on Day 5 with cherished memories of a dynamic and unforgettable Singapore experience.

know_before_you_go: Visa assistance will be provided but the price is not included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.
Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. PAN Card will not be considered valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as proof of identity.
Please note that Singapore has a strict policy against littering in public areas. Heavy fines are in place for those found littering.
In the event of cancellation, the included activities and tickets are non-refundable.
Images are for representation purposes only.
Kindly do not carry any chewing gum as it is banned in Singapore and defaulters will be penalised.
Please note that it is mandatory to purchase travel insurance while visiting Singapore. Travel insurance is not a part of the package price.
Eating and drinking on public transport is not allowed.
Please note that jaywalking is not allowed in Singapore, if caught, fines will be imposed.
Singapore’s climate is commonly tropical and humid. It is advisable to carry light, comfortable clothes.
Smoking is not allowed until and unless you are in a designated smoking area.
While credit card payments are widely accepted in Singapore, it is recommended that you carry some cash for small purchases.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Singapore | Singapore Night Safari
days.desc: Welcome to Singapore! Upon arrival, get driven to your hotel. Post check-in, relax for a while. In the evening, get driven to experience the world-famous Night Safari Singapore, the world’s first nocturnal wildlife park. Once there, discover diverse naturalistic habitats home to over 2,500 animals from across the globe. Enjoy a 45-minute guided tram ride through the jungle trails, spotting nocturnal species such as lions, tigers, fishing cats, and more in their recreated environments.

days.title: Singapore Sightseeing Tour | Garden By The Bay
days.desc: In the morning, set out on a Singapore city tour & visit the iconic Merlion Park, home to the legendary half-lion, half-fish statue overlooking Marina Bay and the city skyline. Continue past the historic Raffles Hotel Singapore, a colonial-era landmark, and cross the futuristic Helix Bridge, a DNA-shaped pedestrian bridge. Next, get driven to Gardens by the Bay and explore the mist-filled Cloud Forest, the climate-controlled Flower Dome, and the immersive Jurassic World Experience.

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: Today, get ready for an exhilarating day at Universal Studios Singapore, Southeast Asia’s premier Hollywood-themed attraction. Upon arrival, dive into a world of cinematic adventure across seven immersive zones, from Hollywood’s glamour to the futuristic thrills of Sci-Fi City, the mysteries of Ancient Egypt, and the fun-filled world of Madagascar. Also, experience adrenaline-pumping rides, spectacular live shows, and interactive street performances featuring beloved movie characters.

days.title: Sentosa Island Day Tour with Singapore Cable Car | Wings of Time Show
days.desc: Today, get transferred to Universal Studios Singapore and from here, proceed to Imbiah Station for a scenic Singapore Cable Car ride, offering breathtaking aerial views of Sentosa’s coastline. Once in Sentosa, you can visit Madame Tussauds Singapore & marvel at lifelike wax figures of global celebrities. In the evening, experience the spectacular Wings of Time, a world-class outdoor night show blending water, laser, fire, and music into a mesmerizing storytelling finale.
